The audit's 10.96 % return reproduces at one decimal (10.99) and its 0.68 ratio comes out one tick higher (0.6934 -> 0.69), but its -54.7 % maxDD does not reproduce here: -54.7 and the audit's TEST -31.7 are both the drawdowns of a 5-bar grid starting 2004-01-05 (1140 marks), whose own return is 10.83 %. Only those two drawdown figures reproduce, and they belong to that offset grid; the audit's returns and ratios match neither grid exactly.
